name: GE Vernova T&D India Limited
summary: GE Vernova T&D India Limited, founded in 1957 in Noida and a subsidiary of Grid Equipments Private Limited, builds power transmission and distribution infrastructure in India and abroad. Its equipment includes HVDC and FACTS power electronics, transformers, circuit breakers, substations, switchgear, capacitors, reactors and control panels, and it also offers turnkey solutions.
